final: WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c), s AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL)/t.total AS share FROM c, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_above, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
